title: LotKeys Info
summary: The V0.9.4.73 team-test build is ready for award and LotKeys Info testing.

blocks.text: LotKeys Info now saves and publishes one stable Google Drive file from Developer Files. Award Drop is organized by category, every new award can reach its recipient in a celebratory popup, and one top-layer celebration effect is shared across LotKeys. The successful Post Buddy download no longer produces a toast error.
